verdict: Google profiles are driving foot traffic; calls are not converting.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity came through your three Google Business Profiles — no paid ads ran on Meta or Google. Your profiles recorded 185 total actions (154 direction requests, 26 website clicks, 5 calls) across 1,070 impressions, and GBP engagement rose 12.5% in the most recent 7-day period. Despite that visibility, only 5 calls were captured across all three locations — a signal that people are finding you but not completing the call, which is a call-capture issue rather than a traffic problem. We're auditing the call setup across all three profiles this week to close that gap and expect to see call volume improve as corrections are made.
